geometry: A 78 by 22 two-row LCD atlas with twelve 5 by 9 cells on a 6-pixel pitch. Explicit stroked numeral and minus paths are reused in bright green and dark green, with black backing, dark upper cell fields, and the original transparent right-side gaps.
limitations: The hand-drawn diagonal and beveled glyph strokes are smooth at scale, so some native-size antialiasing and individual glyph contours differ slightly from the pixel source. Native and 8x renders were inspected.
